## Summary

Manual vote counting is slow and error-prone. This research developed a system that automatically counts votes from scanned election forms by combining feature-matching techniques with a convolutional neural network for accurate recognition.

## Contribution

- Pipeline combining feature matching with CNN classification for scanned forms.
- Demonstrates an applied pattern-recognition solution for document-based public administration.
- Presented at the Scopus-indexed IEEE ICACSIS conference (2019).
